event.title: Spain's World Cup Champions Celebrate with Royal Welcome and Parade
event.canonical_title: Spain's World Cup Champions Celebrate with Royal Welcome and Parade
event.summary: Spain's World Cup-winning football team returned home to a hero's welcome, meeting with the country's royals and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The 26-man squad then paraded through central Madrid on an open-top bus, celebrating their victory over Argentina in front of nearly 2 million fans who lined the streets.

timeline.title: Spain's World Cup Champions Celebrate with Royal Welcome and Parade
timeline.summary: Spain's World Cup-winning football team received a grand welcome from the country's royals and fans in Madrid. The team celebrated their victory over Argentina with a bus parade through the city, where large crowds gathered to show their support.
key_facts: Spain's football team won the World Cup against Argentina.
The team was greeted by royals in Madrid.
A bus parade took place through the city with large crowds.

related_events.title: Spain Claims Second FIFA World Cup Title with Victory Over Argentina
related_events.summary: Spain has won its second FIFA World Cup title, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the final match. Ferran Torres scored the decisive goal in extra time, securing the victory after a 16-year wait for the championship. Fans celebrated the win across Spain and in various locations worldwide, including Times Square in New York.
